info.title: Booster Plus API
info.description: Operational and passwordless identity API. Staff require a second factor on every sign-in. Mutations require browser/session cookies, same-origin Origin, and a fresh CSRF header. Configurable catalog drafts and immutable publications use revision checks. Numeric form values and monetary minor units are exact strings.
